# Dimension Trait Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Define the full public `Dimension` trait contract, the internal `DimensionExt` helper trait, and the `MAX_DIMENSION` constant in `src/dimension/mod.rs` so every later dimension, layout, tensor, broadcast, and indexing module can rely on one stable shape abstraction.

**Architecture:** `src/dimension/mod.rs` owns module wiring, public re-exports, the public sealed `Dimension` trait, and the crate-private `DimensionExt` helper surface. `Dimension` provides read-only shape introspection plus conversion hooks; `DimensionExt` keeps mutating helpers out of the stable public API. The W3T1 tests must only exercise this trait surface itself and must not depend on later `IxDyn` constructors or methods from W3T2.

**Tech Stack:** Rust 1.85+, edition 2024, std

**Design Docs:** `design/02-dimension.md` §5.1 (Dimension trait), `design/02-dimension.md` §5.2 (`MAX_DIMENSION`), `design/02-dimension.md` §10 (error and semantic boundaries), `design/26-error.md` §4.2 (InvalidAxis / InvalidShape / DimensionMismatch payloads)

**Prerequisites:** W2T8 must be complete.

```rust
use crate::error::XenonError;
use crate::private::Sealed;

mod axes;
mod dynamic;
mod into;
mod r#static;

pub use axes::Axis;
pub use dynamic::IxDyn;
pub use into::IntoDimension;
pub use r#static::{Ix0, Ix1, Ix2, Ix3, Ix4, Ix5, Ix6};

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
    struct MockDim {
        dims: [usize; 2],
    }

    impl Sealed for MockDim {}

    impl Dimension for MockDim {
        const NDIM: Option<usize> = Some(2);

        fn ndim(&self) -> usize {
            2
        }

        fn slice(&self) -> &[usize] {
            &self.dims
        }

        fn checked_size(&self) -> Result<usize, XenonError> {
            Ok(self.dims[0] * self.dims[1])
        }

        fn checked(&self) -> Result<(), XenonError> {
            self.checked_size().map(|_| ())
        }

        fn into_dyn(self) -> IxDyn {
            panic!("MockDim::into_dyn is not exercised by W3T1 tests")
        }

        fn try_from_dyn(_dyn_dim: IxDyn) -> Result<Self, XenonError> {
            panic!("MockDim::try_from_dyn is not exercised by W3T1 tests")
        }

        fn try_from_slice(slice: &[usize]) -> Result<Self, XenonError> {
            if slice.len() == 2 {
                Ok(Self {
                    dims: [slice[0], slice[1]],
                })
            } else {
                Err(XenonError::DimensionMismatch {
                    operation: "Dimension::try_from_slice".into(),
                    expected: 2,
                    actual: slice.len(),
                })
            }
        }
    }

    impl DimensionExt for MockDim {
        fn slice_mut(&mut self) -> &mut [usize] {
            &mut self.dims
        }
    }

    fn assert_dimension_signatures<D: Dimension>() {
        let _ndim: fn(&D) -> usize = D::ndim;
        let _slice: fn(&D) -> &[usize] = D::slice;
        let _checked_size: fn(&D) -> Result<usize, XenonError> = D::checked_size;
        let _checked: fn(&D) -> Result<(), XenonError> = D::checked;
        let _into_dyn: fn(D) -> IxDyn = D::into_dyn;
        let _try_from_dyn: fn(IxDyn) -> Result<D, XenonError> = D::try_from_dyn;
        let _try_from_slice: fn(&[usize]) -> Result<D, XenonError> = D::try_from_slice;
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_dimension_trait_signatures_compile() {
        assert_eq!(MAX_DIMENSION, usize::MAX);
        assert_eq!(MockDim::NDIM, Some(2));
        assert_dimension_signatures::<MockDim>();
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_dimension_axis_success() {
        let dim = MockDim { dims: [2, 3] };
        assert_eq!(dim.axis(Axis(1)).unwrap(), 3);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_dimension_axis_invalid_axis_error() {
        let dim = MockDim { dims: [2, 3] };
        let err = dim.axis(Axis(2)).unwrap_err();
        assert!(matches!(
            err,
            XenonError::InvalidAxis {
                operation,
                axis: 2,
                ndim: 2,
                shape,
            } if operation == "Dimension::axis" && shape == vec![2, 3]
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_dimension_ext_contains_zero() {
        let dim = MockDim { dims: [2, 0] };
        assert!(dim.contains_zero());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_dimension_ext_first_last_axis() {
        let dim = MockDim { dims: [2, 3] };
        assert_eq!(dim.first_axis(), Some(Axis(0)));
        assert_eq!(dim.last_axis(), Some(Axis(1)));
    }
}
```

```rust
use core::fmt::Debug;

use crate::error::XenonError;
use crate::private::Sealed;

mod axes;
mod dynamic;
mod into;
mod r#static;

pub use axes::Axis;
pub use dynamic::IxDyn;
pub use into::IntoDimension;
pub use r#static::{Ix0, Ix1, Ix2, Ix3, Ix4, Ix5, Ix6};

/// Sentinel upper bound for dynamic rank.
pub const MAX_DIMENSION: usize = usize::MAX;

/// Trait for array dimension types.
pub trait Dimension: Sealed + Clone + PartialEq + Eq + Debug + Send + Sync + 'static {
    const NDIM: Option<usize>;

    fn ndim(&self) -> usize;

    fn slice(&self) -> &[usize];

    fn checked_size(&self) -> Result<usize, XenonError>;

    fn checked(&self) -> Result<(), XenonError>;

    fn into_dyn(self) -> IxDyn;

    fn try_from_dyn(dyn_dim: IxDyn) -> Result<Self, XenonError>
    where
        Self: Sized;

    fn try_from_slice(slice: &[usize]) -> Result<Self, XenonError>
    where
        Self: Sized;

    fn axis(&self, axis: Axis) -> Result<usize, XenonError> {
        self.slice().get(axis.0).copied().ok_or(XenonError::InvalidAxis {
            operation: "Dimension::axis".into(),
            axis: axis.index(),
            ndim: self.ndim(),
            shape: self.slice().into(),
        })
    }
}

pub(crate) trait DimensionExt: Dimension {
    fn slice_mut(&mut self) -> &mut [usize];

    fn set_axis(&mut self, axis: Axis, value: usize) -> Result<(), XenonError> {
        let ndim = self.ndim();
        let shape = self.slice().to_vec();
        let slot = self.slice_mut().get_mut(axis.0).ok_or(XenonError::InvalidAxis {
            operation: "DimensionExt::set_axis".into(),
            axis: axis.index(),
            ndim,
            shape,
        })?;
        *slot = value;
        Ok(())
    }

    fn last_axis(&self) -> Option<Axis> {
        self.ndim().checked_sub(1).map(Axis)
    }

    fn first_axis(&self) -> Option<Axis> {
        (self.ndim() > 0).then_some(Axis(0))
    }

    fn contains_zero(&self) -> bool {
        self.slice().iter().any(|&d| d == 0)
    }

    fn iter(&self) -> core::slice::Iter<'_, usize> {
        self.slice().iter()
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
    struct MockDim {
        dims: [usize; 2],
    }

    impl Sealed for MockDim {}

    impl Dimension for MockDim {
        const NDIM: Option<usize> = Some(2);

        fn ndim(&self) -> usize {
            2
        }

        fn slice(&self) -> &[usize] {
            &self.dims
        }

        fn checked_size(&self) -> Result<usize, XenonError> {
            Ok(self.dims[0] * self.dims[1])
        }

        fn checked(&self) -> Result<(), XenonError> {
            self.checked_size().map(|_| ())
        }

        fn into_dyn(self) -> IxDyn {
            panic!("MockDim::into_dyn is not exercised by W3T1 tests")
        }

        fn try_from_dyn(_dyn_dim: IxDyn) -> Result<Self, XenonError> {
            panic!("MockDim::try_from_dyn is not exercised by W3T1 tests")
        }

        fn try_from_slice(slice: &[usize]) -> Result<Self, XenonError> {
            if slice.len() == 2 {
                Ok(Self {
                    dims: [slice[0], slice[1]],
                })
            } else {
                Err(XenonError::DimensionMismatch {
                    operation: "Dimension::try_from_slice".into(),
                    expected: 2,
                    actual: slice.len(),
                })
            }
        }
    }

    impl DimensionExt for MockDim {
        fn slice_mut(&mut self) -> &mut [usize] {
            &mut self.dims
        }
    }

    fn assert_dimension_signatures<D: Dimension>() {
        let _ndim: fn(&D) -> usize = D::ndim;
        let _slice: fn(&D) -> &[usize] = D::slice;
        let _checked_size: fn(&D) -> Result<usize, XenonError> = D::checked_size;
        let _checked: fn(&D) -> Result<(), XenonError> = D::checked;
        let _into_dyn: fn(D) -> IxDyn = D::into_dyn;
        let _try_from_dyn: fn(IxDyn) -> Result<D, XenonError> = D::try_from_dyn;
        let _try_from_slice: fn(&[usize]) -> Result<D, XenonError> = D::try_from_slice;
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_dimension_trait_signatures_compile() {
        assert_eq!(MAX_DIMENSION, usize::MAX);
        assert_eq!(MockDim::NDIM, Some(2));
        assert_dimension_signatures::<MockDim>();
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_dimension_axis_success() {
        let dim = MockDim { dims: [2, 3] };
        assert_eq!(dim.axis(Axis(1)).unwrap(), 3);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_dimension_axis_invalid_axis_error() {
        let dim = MockDim { dims: [2, 3] };
        let err = dim.axis(Axis(2)).unwrap_err();
        assert!(matches!(
            err,
            XenonError::InvalidAxis {
                operation,
                axis: 2,
                ndim: 2,
                shape,
            } if operation == "Dimension::axis" && shape == vec![2, 3]

    }

    #[test]
    fn test_dimension_ext_contains_zero() {

    }

    #[test]

        let dim = MockDim { dims: [2, 3] };

    }
}
```
